change_summary: Distinguish broad portfolio context from Project governance, keep decision-ready whole-Page rewrites with the Host, expose literal-search completeness, and make heading style an explicit preserve-or-decimal choice.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill passes broad context without forcing an umbrella Project, keeps decision-ready whole-Page rewrites with the Host, and preserves Corvio delegation for cross-source, typed, structurally unresolved, or context-unsafe work.

server_contract.note: The server advertises the new Skill and contract revisions, carries the portfolio-context versus Project-governance boundary through source manifest, Reply, Mission, and RunOps, and projects the shared execution-owner and literal-search completeness contract through REST and MCP.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.35; their shared server-discovered processing-profile contract remains compatible and needs no CLI protocol change.

help_center.note: Public Help remains compatible because the public Skill page projects this shared package and the release does not change remote MCP connection or installation steps.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the new Skill release; its compact handoff guidance remains compatible while the full Skill carries the Project-governance boundary.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Harness distinguishes portfolio context from Project governance, preserves full-body compatibility, defines Host-versus-Corvio routing by total successful-work cost, and records Writer heading intent without adding Runtime semantic classifiers.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests plus cross-host matrices cover progressive reads, exact patches, owner ROI, model identity, heading-style intent, portfolio topology, coherent-single-Project counter-boundaries, effects, and readback. The committed Cowork/WorkBuddy grid remains pending real fresh-host operator receipts.
